text: The robot handled 22 out of 74 orders successfully within an average time of 103 seconds per order, with a median of 95 seconds. The top failure reason was "unknown" issues, which occurred in [cite:7] and [cite:6]. Orders #2 (water bottle) took the longest at over 8 minutes, highlighting that slow orders often involved items requiring precise handling or unfamiliar products. To address this, focus on monitoring orders involving unfamiliar items closely to prevent delays due to "unknown" failures.
